channel.title: Project Roles on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Project Roles on KubeSphere

item.title: Create Project Role
item.description: This section describes how to create a project role. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Role Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Role Management permissions and enter your workspace. Click Project Management > Project Role in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Project Role List
item.description: This section describes how to view the project role list. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Role Viewing permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Role Viewing permissions and enter your workspace. Click Project Management > Project Roles in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Project Role Details
item.description: This section describes how to view project role details. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Role Viewing permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Role Viewing permissions and enter your workspace. Click Project Management > Project Roles in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Project Role Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit project role information. You can edit the alias and description of project roles created by users. KubeSphere does not support editing built-in project roles, nor does it support editing the names of project roles. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Role Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Role Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Edit Project Role Permissions
item.description: This section describes how to edit project role permissions. You can only edit the permissions of user-created project roles. The permissions of built-in project roles cannot be edited. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Role Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Role Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Delete Project Role
item.description: This section describes how to delete a project role. You can delete project roles created by users. Built-in project roles cannot be deleted. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Role Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. If the project role you want to delete has already been assigned to project members, you need to remove those project members or modify their roles.
